Kanjidon vs Duolingo Japanese: Which Fits Your Study Goals?

Kanjidon Team · Feb 3, 2026

This is not a contest between two versions of the same product. Duolingo offers a broad Japanese course with sentence lessons and a dedicated character area. Kanjidon specialises in kana, kanji, vocabulary and JLPT-oriented practice with collectible cards and 16 quiz types. Choose according to the gap in your study, not the size of either brand.

Quick Comparison

AreaKanjidonDuolingo Japanese
Primary scopeKana, kanji, vocabulary and JLPT-oriented studyBroad Japanese course with vocabulary, sentences and characters
Kanji organisationGrouped around JLPT pathsIntegrated into course progress and a character tab
Character exercisesMultiple recognition, listening, drawing and speaking-related quiz formatsReading, pronunciation, components, tracing, freehand writing and puzzles
Content library6,000+ kanji and vocabulary cards in totalCourse content evolves by platform and rollout
GamificationCard collection, packs, missions and competitive systemsStreaks, XP, leagues and course progression

Duolingo Does Teach Japanese Characters

Claims that Duolingo has no serious kanji tools are outdated. Its official guide describes a character tab where learners practise reading and pronunciation, inspect components, trace characters, write them freehand and solve character puzzles. The exact experience can change as courses and features are updated, so judge the version available on your device.

Kanjidon Goes Deeper on the Specialist Workflow

Kanjidon is built around Japanese writing and JLPT-oriented study rather than a general course tree. Its library contains more than 6,000 kanji and vocabulary cards in total, with 16 quiz formats that can examine different aspects of recall. The free path covers kana and N5 study and includes 10 welcome packs; Premium expands access. The app has no advertising.

Broad Course or Targeted Practice

Duolingo can provide a guided sequence of sentence-level exposure across vocabulary, reading, listening and grammar. That breadth is useful to a learner who wants one accessible routine. Kanjidon is more suitable when the immediate question is narrower: which kanji or vocabulary should I review for a JLPT level, and can I test it in more than one way?

Neither app alone proves reading fluency. Extensive reading, listening, grammar study and interaction with real Japanese still matter. A character recognised inside an exercise is only useful when you can understand it in a word and sentence.

Spaced Review Without Marketing Myths

Both products schedule practice inside their own systems, but their algorithms and product goals are not identical. It would be misleading to claim that one universal algorithm ensures stronger retention. Compare the practical result: does the app surface forgotten material, can you answer without hints, and can you still recognise it elsewhere?

Who Should Start with Duolingo?

  • Absolute beginners who want a broad, guided introduction.
  • Learners who enjoy short sentence lessons and a familiar course path.
  • People who want character work beside general vocabulary and grammar exposure.
  • Learners who are not currently targeting a specific JLPT level.

Who Should Add or Choose Kanjidon?

  • Learners who want kana and kanji organised around JLPT levels.
  • People who benefit from card collection, packs and varied quiz formats.
  • Learners who want dedicated recognition, listening, drawing and speaking-related practice.
  • Anyone who wants to compare a specialist free N5 path with their current routine.

A Sensible Two-App Setup

If you enjoy Duolingo, there is no need to abandon it. Give it the broad-course role and use Kanjidon for a smaller target, such as N5 kanji review. After two weeks, check whether the second app adds a distinct skill or merely duplicates easy recognition. Keep it only if the roles are genuinely different.

Official Sources and Update Note

Duolingo features were reviewed against its official Japanese reading guide on August 29, 2026. Courses and subscription details can change.
